entries.phase_name: Honest Plan Orchestration Across Go and TypeScript
entries.description: .aether/ts-host/src/lifecycle.ts maps plan-only dispatches into status=completed and writes a top-level synthetic phase_plan before calling plan-finalize; no real planning dispatcher supplies those results.

entries.phase_name: Honest Plan Orchestration Across Go and TypeScript
entries.description: cmd/codex_plan_finalize.go returns completion.PhasePlan before checking route-setter-owned phase plans or claimed fresh artifacts, then labels the output external-task/external planning workers.

entries.phase_name: Honest Plan Orchestration Across Go and TypeScript
entries.description: buildWorkerPlanPhases skips empty task goals but still appends phases, while runCodexPlanFinalize only checks len(phases)>0, so a phase_plan with phases but no tasks can be persisted.

entries.phase_name: Honest Plan Orchestration Across Go and TypeScript
entries.description: lifecycle-honesty.test.ts covers simulation opt-in and platform availability, while boundary tests cover tmpdir writes; neither asserts that runLifecycle avoids completed planning claims.
